title: Monthly report generation
explanation: ReportService.monthly_report is async, but on line 23 it calls the warehouse SDK's synchronous fetch_transactions, which blocks for about 200 ms (time.sleep in app/warehouse.py, line 22). A blocking call inside an async function freezes the whole event loop, so while any report is being built the server can't answer anything else, including /health. Under concurrent report requests every endpoint queues behind them and latency climbs to many seconds.
expected_fix: Run the synchronous query off the event loop: await run_in_threadpool(...) or asyncio.to_thread(...), or make the route a plain def so FastAPI runs it in its thread pool, or switch to an async client.
grill_expected_points: fetch_transactions is a blocking call made directly inside an async function.
A blocking call freezes the event loop, so every other request, including /health, waits until it finishes.
Fix it by running the query in a thread pool (run_in_threadpool or asyncio.to_thread), a sync route, or an async client.
chaos_invariant: /health p95 stays under 200 ms while reports are being generated
grill_question: While 100 reports were being generated, even /health took seconds to answer, though it does no work at all. Why?
grill_follow_up: What does the event loop do while fetch_transactions is waiting on the warehouse?

fix_steps.description: Identifies that a synchronous SDK call runs inside an async route.
look_for: mentions time.sleep or the synchronous SDK
hints: Look at what the report route waits on.
Is the warehouse call something the event loop can switch away from while it waits?
A synchronous call inside an async function blocks the event loop until it returns.

fix_steps.title: Move it off the event loop
fix_steps.description: Runs the query in a worker thread, or makes the route synchronous so FastAPI uses its thread pool.
look_for: or changes the route to def
hints: Check where the slow query runs once you've changed it.
How can a blocking call run without stopping the event loop?
Run the query in a thread pool so the event loop keeps serving other requests.

fix_steps.description: Makes sure compare and CSV export, which reuse monthly_report, get the fix too.
look_for: fixes it inside monthly_report rather than one route
hints: Look at every route that ends up calling the warehouse.
If you only fix one route, do the others still block?
Fix it in monthly_report so every route that uses it benefits.
